candidates.name: Inngest
candidates.description: Inngest is the durable execution platform for anyone who wants their product to work as expected for every user, at any scale, without thinking about infrastructure. Add step-level retries, recovery, and flow control to any codebase just by adding functions. When things break, see exactly what happened, and pick up exactly where you left off. No workers, no queues, no constraints on how code is written, or where it runs. Whether you're building AI agents, serverless background jobs, or event-driven workflows—Inngest makes any code durable by default.
candidates.rationale: Very similar developer platform: durable background jobs/workflows for TypeScript/serverless apps, targeting the same buyer persona and use case.

candidates.name: Marmut
candidates.description: Marmut is a genAI workflow orchestration platform focused on large-context. Be it large documents which are 1000 pages long or just a lot of content on the internet, we can help solve these issues where almost all LLMs/agents fail. For documents, we focus on helping businesses make sense of large documents with unprecedented depth helping you get the most from your generative AI setups. Large regulations and policies can be easily broken down, structured and evaluated for compliance, benchmarking and audit purpose like never before. For getting information from public sources on internet, marmut platform can be customized as per your requirement to get the data, at the depth you require, on demand or on schedule. This can range from getting information regarding adverse observations on organizations to getting data on regulations from the Federal Register, EUR-Lex and more.
candidates.rationale: Different product category: Marmut is genAI document/data orchestration, while Trigger.dev is a developer workflow/background jobs platform.

candidates.name: OpenHands
candidates.description: OpenHands is the agent control plane for platform teams. Most AI tools help you write code, but the work still happens manually. OpenHands closes that gap by turning everyday tasks into agents and workflows that actually run across your stack. What starts as a prompt becomes something repeatable, observable, and part of how your team operates. It is built in the open because you should be able to see how agents work and control how they run. OpenHands is open source, model-agnostic, and deployable in your environment, so you decide what it connects to and how it behaves. The vision is simple: move from assistants to systems, where AI runs real parts of the development process in a way teams can trust.
candidates.rationale: Different product category: OpenHands is AI agent orchestration; Trigger.dev is background jobs/workflow infrastructure for TypeScript developers.
